data.text:
#MSNews | In support of the Philippines’ hosting of the FIVB Volleyball Men's World Championship 2025, weekend mall-wide sales are temporarily banned in shopping malls located near the two venues of the international tournament.

The tournament, scheduled to take place at two primary venues: the SM Mall of Asia Arena in Pasay City and the Smart Araneta Coliseum in Quezon City, featuring teams from 32 different countries.

The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority has issued a Memorandum Circular indicating that there will be no mall-wide sales in shopping centers near the Smart Araneta Coliseum and SM Mall of Asia Arena on September 12-14; as well as on September 20-21 and September 27-28, to prevent heavy traffic and overcrowding near the venues during crucial match weekends.

The MMDA will assign traffic personnel to manage traffic flow and ensure the safety of all participants. | via Joel Zurbano

For more news updates, visit https://t.co/rmQCnNSOvI.

data.text:
Sa Quezon City, no pet is left behind 🐾

Agad na kumilos ang mga kawani ng Quezon City Veterinary Department (QCVD) upang bigyan ng lunas ang mga alagang hayop na naapektuhan ng sunog sa Brgy. Culiat. 

Sa kabuuan, mayroong 54 na aso at pusa ang nadamay sa naganap na sunog. Nagtayo ng pet evacuation area ang QCVD, at mayroong 16 na aso at pusa ang inilagak rito. Binigyan ng vitamins ang mga aso at pusa na kasama sa mga naapektuhan ng nangyaring sunog.

Patuloy na babantayan ang kondisyon ng mga hayop kasabay na rin ang patuloy na pagbibigay ng malinis na tubig at pagkain sa mga ito bukod sa atensyong medikal.

Paalala po sa lahat ng pet parents sa evacuation areas, makiisa at tulungan po natin ang ating mga Barangay Animal Control Officers (BACO) sa pagpapanatili ng kalinisan sa mga pet areas. 

Sa panahon ng sakuna kasama ang inyong alaga.

IN PHOTOS: The City Government of Valenzuela met with Mr. Jean Todt, the United Nations Secretary-General’s Special Envoy for Road Safety, to discuss the city’s initiatives on child road safety. As part of the visit, they also went to Pasolo Elementary School, which has been awarded the Safe School Seal for implementing street infrastructure interventions to improve pedestrian safety.

Coun. Niña Lopez delivered a presentation emphasizing the importance of safer streets for children. Ms. Dorothy Go Evangelista, Chief of Staff on Social Welfare Operations, also engaged with participants, responding to questions for the continuous improvement in road safety. Mr. Jean Todt also signed a guest book, symbolizing support for the city's ongoing road safety initiatives.

As one of the pilot cities in the Philippines for Star Ratings for Schools (SR4S), Valenzuela highlighted key outcomes, achievements, and challenges in promoting road safety for Valenzuelano children. The dialogue addressed the ongoing challenges schools face in implementing road traffic safety measures and explored new opportunities for the city government units, the United Nations, and other partners.

Through the continued sharing of knowledge, resources, and best practices, Valenzuela City and its partners reaffirmed their collective goal of making roads safer for every child. Aligned with this, we uphold the principle of equal opportunity by hiring senior citizens without discrimination, fostering safer roads for everyone.

Traffic Advisory – Cornerstone Chapel Area 🚨

This morning, local traffic will be affected to accommodate the Celebration of Life for Loudoun County Combined Fire & Rescue System Captain Dannie Wilson and the parking of Loudoun County emergency apparatus.

Expect traffic disruptions and lane closures in the area surrounding Cornerstone Chapel beginning at approximately 9:00 a.m. and lasting until about 1:00 p.m.

We encourage drivers to use alternate routes and allow extra travel time. Thank you for your patience as our community comes together to honor Captain Wilson.
